firstShown.explanation: Rule: residents remain in FIFO order unless removed; live entries may be replaced in place, while tombstones block replacement. Admission evicts the oldest unpinned resident, but never a pinned resident. Pinning protects entries; invalidation tombstones pinned entries, and the final unpin removes such a tombstone. A contrasting alternative—reordering on get or replacing tombstones—fails the stated FIFO and tombstone requirements.
firstShown.mapping: The state maps each resident key to {value,pins,tombstone} plus an ordered resident-key array. Outputs project that state into order, pins, sorted tombstones, status, and get value.
firstShown.assumptions: Statuses use the operation-result names: stored, pinned, released, invalidated, removed, missing, hit, miss, blocked, and ignored. Non-get outputs have value null.
firstShown.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const o of output){if(!o||!Array.isArray(o.order)||!o.pins||!Array.isArray(o.tombstones)||!('status' in o)||!('value' in o))return false;if(o.value!==null&&typeof o.value!=='number')return false}return true}
